items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: You played with Punch Miller and with Eddie Condon and some of the other musicians on the scene.

ctx.x: antique shops and every once in a while they shut off the streets and they have sales of local people's wares. It's a good camaraderie here among the neighbors.
Nice, pleasant little community, I gather.

Well, listen, Chief, between the time you did that Indian school tour and the time you joined Louis Armstrong the second time, what kinds of things did you do? Did you have your own group or did you do a lot of sitting in in New York or did you do a lot of -- Okay, so during the early 60s you were playing around with a lot of musicians as we mentioned before. You played with Punch Miller and with Eddie Condon and some of the other musicians on the scene.
